stage: Before full anchored-key enumeration and new control outcomes
question: Does the previously observed FOOL conditional fit survive broader controls, characterize a readable whole message, or yield unchanged cross-message predictions?

anchor.status: Community conjecture selected after seeing game text, not ground truth

family: Unchanged R33/R36 fixed nonempty 1..3 uppercase letters per observed digit, shared across seven numeric groups; each group a word in the pinned CMU bank plus historical BONELORD
new_solver: Exact trie-backed enumeration with forced anchor, complete key set; qualify by independent whole-key enumeration and verify all real witnesses. No language score or key ranking.

controls.sampling: Seeded independent draws from declared permutations, retain duplicates and identity; no success-dependent rejection. Distinct groups shuffled consistently in first family. Pooled type keeps first six word lengths and their pooled digit multiset, last group345unchanged.
controls.statistic: Number of conditional lexical keys; report positives, complete/limited counts and >= real-count comparisons. Descriptive sensitivity only, no inferential p-value because anchor and question are post-selection.
controls.all_earlier_controls_status: Previously exposed, not fresh held-out evidence

transfer.selection: Every canonical_candidate in data/source_validation_inventory.json except Knightmare; preserve source grouping and duplicate-message identity
transfer.key_rule: Use all3976unchanged keys; no digit2completion, lore repair or best-key choice
modes: Each numeric group is one lexical word
Each numeric group may be segmented into a sequence of lexical words, with supplied group boundaries retained
transfer.semantic_validation: No withheld English answers available. Lexical matches alone cannot validate translation; missing digits are unavailable, never rejection.

word_attestation_sensitivity.normalization: Regex ASCII alphabetic runs uppercase on full pinned files, including headers; count forms occurring at least once. Same three sources as R35, used as a sensitivity subset only, no score/ranking.
word_attestation_sensitivity.scope: Not a complete English lexicon or proper-name classifier; absence excludes only this restricted source subset.
